response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but the profile does not match the core mandatory requirements. C++ exposure is limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 plus a university thesis project, far short of the 5–10 years of hands-on C++ required, and there is no evidence of Windows-platform C++ work at scale. Database experience is MongoDB/MySQL rather than SQL Server or Oracle, and financial-domain exposure is limited to a German retail investment fintech (RIDE Capital) using Node/TypeScript, not fixed income, derivatives, or capital-markets/investment-banking systems. The overall trajectory is web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang), which is a poor fit for a low-latency C++ capital-markets consulting engagement.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience across web, mobile, and embedded
Strong low-latency systems work (high-throughput microservices, async I/O, fibers)
Excellent communication evidenced by talks, workshops, and courses
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++; no recent or Windows-based C++ work
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment-banking/capital-markets domain experience
SQL depth unclear; no SQL Server or Oracle exposure listed

key_factors.factor: Missing capital markets / fixed income domain
